name: sparkx-create-campaign
description: Create new Amazon Sponsored Products campaigns in bulk through `create_sp_sb_campaign`, or add ad groups to an existing SP campaign through `create_sp_ad_group` - promoted products, negatives, and either auto targeting, keywords, or product targets. New-campaign creation also supports placement adjustments and an optional audience. Use when the user wants to build / launch / set up a new campaign - 新建广告活动 / 建一个自动广告 / 开个手动词的活动 / 按这批 ASIN 建活动 - or add ad groups under an existing SP campaign. It is not for editing existing objects (use sparkx-edit-ads), for AI managed groups (use sparkx-create-ai-group), or for reading data (use sparkx-query-ads-performance / sparkx-query-entity-metadata).
